# Set-up details and utilities
Hidden cells load required modules, load theme, set up and establish graphics size and coordinates,
and define labelling functions for \(y\)-axis.
Overall simulation parameters are set as constants. 
```{julia}
#| echo: false
using EpidemicsCFTP, EpidemicsUtilities, Gadfly, Compose ;
```
```{julia}
const duration   = 15 ;
const MAXPOP  = 20 ;
const initial= SIR(0.0, 4, 1, 0)
const population = 5 ;
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
theme = create_theme(load_theme("config/theme.yml")) ;

gadfly_theme = Theme(
    panel_fill=theme.blank,
    default_color=theme.default,
    background_color=theme.background,
    major_label_font="CMU Serif",   minor_label_font="CMU Serif",
    minor_label_color=theme.legend, major_label_color=theme.legend,
    major_label_font_size=8pt,     minor_label_font_size=6pt,
    grid_line_width=0mm,
)

set_default_plot_size(theme.figwidth, theme.figheight) ;

if population > MAXPOP
  error("`population` exceeds `$(MAXPOP)`: modify code indexing time-lines!")
end ;
if initial.n > MAXPOP                                                                  
    circlabels = ["[$i]" for i in 1:initial.n]                                                                                         
else                                                                                    
    circlabels = [string(Char(codepoint('①') + i - 1)) for i in 1:initial.n]                                                           
end                                                                                     
function timelinelabels1(i) 
    (round(i) > 0 && i ≤ initial.n) ? circlabels[round(Int, i)] : "" 
end ;                                                                             
function timelinelabels2(i) 
    (i ≤ initial.n) ? string(trunc(Int, i)) : ""
end ;                                                                             
```

It is convenient to abbreviate various types of incident.
```{julia}
A = AbstractInfection ; R = Removal ; C = CRemoval ; I = Infection ; P = PInfection ;
```

# Production of Figure 1
We first generate a precise equivalent of @ConnorKendall-2023 [Figure 1].

**Caption in draft paper:** 
"Graphical representation of unconditioned \(\SIR\) epidemic. There are five time-lines."

Here is the set of innovations, with epidemic effects tabulated in @tbl-evolution.
```{julia}
#| echo: false
innov_figure1 = Innovation(duration, 
  A[I(1.0,2,5),  I(2.0,1,2),  I(3.0,1,2),  I(4.0,2,4),  I(6.0,3,4),  I(7.0,2,3),  I(8.0,1,2), 
    I(8.0,4,5),  I(9.0,1,4),  I(11.0,2,4), I(14.5,3,5)], 
  R[R(3.0,5),    R(5.0,1),    R(7.5,5),  R(13.0,3),   R(14.0,3)],  C[])
```
The incidents for the resulting epidemic evolution are illustrated in @fig-nodes1.
```{julia}
#| label: tbl-evolution
#| tbl-cap: Table giving evolution of the first epidemic
#| echo: false 
ev1 = Evolution(initial, innov_figure1)

flow1 = table_trajectories1(duration, ev1.trajectory)
```


```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-nodes1
#| fig-cap: "Illustration of nodes as used in Figure 1 of @ConnorKendall-2023. `[production-draftfigure0]`"
timelines = layer(flow1, yintercept=1:initial.n,
    Geom.hline(style=:dot, size=0.25mm),
    style(default_color=theme.scaffold))

fig0 = plot(flow1,  x=:t, y=:empty, Geom.line(),
    Coord.cartesian(xmin=0, xmax=duration, ymin=0, ymax=initial.n+0.25),
    Scale.x_continuous(),
    Guide.xlabel("Process time", orientation=:horizontal),
    gadfly_theme
    )
    
fig0 = push!(fig0, timelines)

fig_inc = deepcopy(fig0)
fig_inc = push!(fig_inc,    
    Scale.y_continuous(labels=timelinelabels1),
    Guide.yticks(ticks=collect(1:(initial.n))),
    Guide.ylabel("Time lines"),
    )

fig_nodes0 = deepcopy(fig_inc)
fig_nodes0 = push!(fig_nodes0,
    Guide.annotation(compose(context(),
        EpidemicsUtilities.draw_elements(innov_figure1; theme=theme)))
    )
depict("production-draftfigure0", fig_nodes0)
```

@fig-production-draftfigure1a illustrates the resulting epidemic in terms of infectious and removal zones,
while 
@fig-production-draftfigure1b illustrates the corresponding epidemic, susceptible and removal trajectories.
```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-production-draftfigure1a
#| fig-cap: "@fig-nodes1 plus infectious and removal boundaries. Activated incidents have coloured       \
#|           backgrounds and thicker line-widths. Epidemic/removal regions are coloured tan/light-brown. \
#|           This is a candidate for Figure 1a of @ConnorKendall-2023. `[production-draftfigure1a]`"
evolution1 = Evolution(initial, innov_figure1)

lz2b = layer(flow1, x=:t, y=:removals, Geom.step,
    style(line_width=theme.boundary, default_color=theme.colour(R)))
lz4 = layer(flow1, x=:t, y=:epidemic, Geom.step,
    style(line_width=theme.trail, default_color=theme.colour(I)))
lz5 = layer(flow1, x=:t, y=:population, Geom.line,
    style(line_width=theme.trail, default_color=theme.scaffold))

flow1a = table_trajectories2(flow1, theme=theme) ;
ll6 = layer(flow1a, x=:t, ymin=:removals, ymax=:epidemic, Geom.ribbon,
    alpha=[theme.opacity], style(default_color=theme.colour(I)))
ll7 = layer(flow1a, x=:t, ymin=:empty, ymax=:removals, Geom.ribbon,
    alpha=[2theme.opacity], style(default_color=theme.colour(R)))

fig_inc1 = deepcopy(fig_inc)

fig_inc1 = push!(fig_inc1,   
    Guide.annotation(compose(context(),
        EpidemicsUtilities.draw_activated_elements(initial, evolution1.history, theme=theme)))
    )
fig_inc1 =  push!(fig_inc1,
    Guide.annotation(compose(context(),
        EpidemicsUtilities.draw_elements(innov_figure1; theme=theme)))
    )


fig_inc1 = push!(fig_inc1, lz4, lz2b)
fig_inc1 = push!(fig_inc1, ll6, ll7)    

draftfigure1a = deepcopy(fig_inc1)

depict("production-draftfigure1a", draftfigure1a)
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-production-draftfigure1b
#| fig-cap: "Trajectories of susceptibles (orange solid line), infectives (grey dashed line),        \
#|           removals (brown dashed line).                                                           \
#|           This is a candidate for Figure 1b of @ConnorKendall-2023. `[production-draftfigure1b]`"  

fig_traj = deepcopy(fig0)
fig_traj = push!(fig_traj, Scale.y_continuous(labels=timelinelabels2),
    Guide.ylabel("Numbers of individuals"),
    Guide.title("Epidemic curve with removals and susceptibles")
    )
draftfigure1a = deepcopy(fig0)

ll0 = layer(flow1, x=:t, y=:empty, Geom.line,
    style(line_width=2theme.trail, default_color=theme.scaffold))
ll1 = layer(flow1, x=:t, y=:infectives, Geom.step,
    style(line_width=theme.trail,  default_color=theme.colour(I)))
ll2 = layer(flow1, x=:t, y=:removals, Geom.step,
    style(line_style=[:dashdot], line_width=theme.boundary, default_color=theme.colour(R)))
ll3 = layer(flow1[flow1.susceptibles.!=0, :], x=:t, y=:susceptibles, Geom.step,
    style(line_style=[:dash], line_width=theme.boundary, default_color=theme.scaffold))

figure_1b = deepcopy(fig_traj)
push!(figure_1b, ll0, ll3, ll2, ll1)

depict("production-draftfigure1b", figure_1b)
```

# Production of Figure 3
We now generate a precise equivalent of @ConnorKendall-2023 [Figure 3].

**Caption in draft paper:** 
"Modified graphical representation of \(\SIR\) epidemic, conditioned on removals. ..."

Here is the set of innovations:
```{julia}
#| echo: false
innov_figure3 = Innovation(duration, 
  A[I(0.5,2,5),I(2.0,1,2),  I(2.5,3,4),I(3.0,1,3),  I(5.0,2,4),  I(5.5,3,4),
    I(6.0,2,3),  I(8.0,2,5),  I(9.5,1,3),I(10.0,4,5), I(11.0,4,5), I(12.5,3,5)],
  R[R(1.0,5),   R(2.0,4),  R(4.0,4),  R(7.0,5)],
  C[C(3.5,1), C(6.5,4),C(7.0,3),  C(12.0,5), C(13.0,5)])
```
The effect of these is tabulated in @tbl-table3
and zones are illustrated in @fig-production-draftfigure3-0.


```{julia}
#| label: tbl-table3
#| tbl-cap: Table giving evolution of the second epidemic
#| echo: false
evolution3 = Evolution(initial, innov_figure3)


flow3 = table_trajectories1(duration, evolution3.trajectory) ;


lx2 = layer(flow3, x=:t, y=:removals, Geom.step,
    style(line_width=theme.boundary, default_color=theme.colour(R)))
lx4 = layer(flow3, x=:t, y=:epidemic, Geom.step,
    style(line_width=theme.trail, default_color=theme.colour(I)))
lx5 = layer(flow3, x=:t, y=:population, Geom.line,
    style(line_width=theme.trail, default_color=theme.scaffold))

flow3
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-production-draftfigure3-0
#| fig-cap: "Nodes used in Figure 3 of @ConnorKendall-2023. `[production-draftfigure3-0]`"
fig_nodes3 = deepcopy(fig_inc)
fig_nodes3 = push!(fig_nodes3,
    Guide.annotation(compose(context(),
        EpidemicsUtilities.draw_elements(innov_figure3; theme=theme)))
    )
depict("production-draftfigure3-0", fig_nodes3)
```

@ConnorKendall-2023 Figure 3 is made up of (boundaries and zones) @fig-production-draftfigure3a
and (trajectories) @fig-production-draftfigure3b.




```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-production-draftfigure3a
#| fig-cap: "@fig-production-draftfigure3-0 plus epidemic and removal boundaries. Activated incidents have \
#|           coloured backgrounds and thicker line-widths. Epidemic/removal regions are                   \
#|           coloured tan/light-brown.                                                                    \
#|           This is a candidate for Figure 3a of @ConnorKendall-2023. `[production-draftfigure3a]`" 

flow3a = table_trajectories2(flow3, theme=theme) ;
ll6 = layer(flow3a, x=:t, ymin=:removals, ymax=:epidemic, Geom.ribbon,
    alpha=[theme.opacity], style(default_color=theme.colour(I)))
ll7 = layer(flow3a, x=:t, ymin=:empty, ymax=:removals, Geom.ribbon,
    alpha=[2theme.opacity], style(default_color=theme.colour(R)))


fig_inc3 = deepcopy(fig_inc)

fig_inc3 = push!(fig_inc3,   
    Guide.annotation(compose(context(),
        EpidemicsUtilities.draw_activated_elements(initial, evolution3.history, theme=theme)))
    )
fig_inc3 =  push!(fig_inc3,
    Guide.annotation(compose(context(),
        EpidemicsUtilities.draw_elements(innov_figure3; theme=theme)))
    )

    
fig_inc3 = push!(fig_inc3, lx2, lx4)
fig_inc3 = push!(fig_inc3, ll6, ll7)    

draftfigure3a = deepcopy(fig_inc3)

    
depict("production-draftfigure3a", draftfigure3a)
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-production-draftfigure3b
#| fig-cap: "Trajectories of susceptibles (orange solid line), infectives (grey dashed line),        \
#|           removals (brown dashed line).                                                           \
#|           This is a candidate for Figure 3b of @ConnorKendall-2023. `[production-draftfigure3b]` " 
ll1d = layer(flow3, x=:t, y=:infectives, Geom.step,
    style(line_width=theme.trail,  default_color=theme.colour(I)))
ll2d = layer(flow3, x=:t, y=:removals, Geom.step,
    style(line_style=[:dashdot], line_width=theme.boundary, default_color=theme.colour(R)))
ll3d = layer(flow3, x=:t, y=:susceptibles, Geom.step,
    style(line_style=[:dash], line_width=theme.boundary, default_color=theme.scaffold))
    

figure_3b = deepcopy(fig_traj)
push!(figure_3b, ll3d, ll2d, ll1d)

depict("production-draftfigure3b", figure_3b)
```
